name: exiD: Highway Entrance and Exit Drone Trajectory Dataset
description: Naturalistic vehicle trajectory dataset collected with aerial drones at 7 highway entrance and exit ramp locations in Germany, capturing 70,000 highly interactive highway merging, weaving, and lane-change maneuvers across 16 recording hours.

source_references.notes: IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV 2022) publication by Moers et al. presenting the highway entrance and exit trajectory benchmark.

verification.notes: Verified against levelXData exiD portal and IEEE IV 2022 publication (DOI: 10.1109/IV51971.2022.9827305).

size.notes: levelXData distributes individual CSV files per recording after academic registration approval; a single fixed aggregate archive size is not officially published.

citation.paper_title: The exiD Dataset: A Real-World Trajectory Dataset of Highly Interactive Highway Scenarios in Germany

provenance.collection_method: Recorded with high-resolution aerial drone cameras stationed above 7 distinct highway entrance and exit ramp locations in Germany.
provenance.curation_notes: Captures 70,000 vehicle trajectories over 16 hours of video across acceleration and deceleration lanes, highlighting high-speed merging and lane-change interactions.
